evidenceRefs.observation: Legible invoice from Aurora Store for an Aurora Tab 10 (AUR-TAB10), serial AT10-24-0006, 450.00 USD, dated on the stated purchase date.
Front photo: black, unlit screen; no cracks, dents or liquid marks.
Back photo: the serial label reads AT10-24-0007, not the claimed AT10-24-0006.

structuredOutput.reasoningSummary: The invoice (EV-1) matches the claimed seller, model, serial AT10-24-0006, price and purchase date, and a power failure during normal use would be a manufacturing defect covered by POL-8 within the 12-month North America period of POL-1. However, the serial label in the back photo (EV-3) reads AT10-24-0007, so it is not certain that the photographed unit is the claimed product. Recommend human review to confirm the unit before a decision.
